# Example contradicts instruction (STR002)

A few-shot example that violates a stated rule; the example wins.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `str-example-contradicts-rule` |
| Family | structural |
| Applies to | `prompt` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | prac |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

An example breaks a rule the prompt states. The example usually wins over the rule.

Bad:  Rule: never use contractions. Example answer: don't do that.
Good: Rule: never use contractions. Example answer: do not do that.

Not a finding when every example obeys the rule.

## Detector metadata

```yaml
- kind: llm
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
```
